data.incumbent: A homegrown billing system, built by a person who left; the alternative was doing nothing

evidence.excerpt: There wasn't one big thing.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Rep says no single trigger event started the evaluation.

evidence.excerpt: Their VP of Product, Owen, had wanted to rebuild billing for a while.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Long-standing desire by the champion, not a discrete event.

evidence.excerpt: The billing system is homegrown, built by a guy who left, and every pricing change takes them a quarter.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Incumbent is homegrown; key-person risk; pricing changes take a quarter.

evidence.excerpt: He reached out to us.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Inbound from Owen.

evidence.excerpt: He wanted it done before they launched a new pricing tier, but the tier didn't have a date either.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: No hard deadline; soft driver tied to an undated pricing tier.

evidence.excerpt: The CFO, I guess? Diane.
evidence.label: opinion
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Rep hedges on who made the final call.

evidence.excerpt: They missed their number in Q3 and she put a hold on all new vendor projects.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Company-wide freeze after missed Q3; relayed via Owen.

evidence.excerpt: So I don't know that you'd say she decided against us. She decided against everything.
evidence.label: opinion
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Rep frames outcome as a blanket freeze, not a decision against us.

evidence.excerpt: Owen told me. I never spoke to her.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Decider info is secondhand; rep never spoke to Diane.

evidence.excerpt: No. Owen said he'd bring her in at the end.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Diane was in no meetings; economic buyer engaged late or never.

evidence.excerpt: There wasn't one. It was us against doing nothing.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: No competitor; status quo was the alternative.

evidence.excerpt: Owen never looked at anybody else, as far as I know.
evidence.label: opinion
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Hedged; rep can't be sure no other vendors were considered.

evidence.excerpt: Toward the end Owen started asking for things for finance.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Shift in customer questions toward finance justification.

evidence.excerpt: "do you have something that shows payback?"
evidence.label: quote
evidence.speaker: Owen
evidence.note: Customer asked for payback evidence.

evidence.excerpt: That started maybe a month before the freeze.
evidence.label: opinion
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Timing hedged with 'maybe'; later given as 'about a month'.

evidence.excerpt: Reaction: the billing demo. Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Demo of price changes, trials, proration drew reaction.

evidence.excerpt: "that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes."
evidence.label: quote
evidence.speaker: Owen
evidence.note: Owen's reaction to the demo.

evidence.excerpt: His engineers were into it.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Engineers responded positively to demo.

evidence.excerpt: I don't know that anything got silence.
evidence.label: opinion
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Hedged, then names revenue framing as silence.

evidence.excerpt: We only ever talked to product and engineering.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: No finance contact; multithreading gap.

evidence.excerpt: "we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap."
evidence.label: quote
evidence.speaker: Owen
evidence.note: Owen rejected the revenue-growth framing.

evidence.excerpt: The freeze email.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Rep's first sign it wouldn't close was a freeze email.

evidence.label: fact

evidence.label: quote
evidence.speaker: Owen

evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee

evidence.excerpt: About a month.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Gap between payback ask and freeze.

evidence.excerpt: The number. Their own. What the homegrown system costs them.
evidence.label: fact
evidence.speaker: Renee
evidence.note: Unmet need: customer-specific cost of current system.

evidence.label: fact

evidence.note: Migration questions: no re-collection of cards, staged rollout.

evidence.label: quote

evidence.label: fact

evidence.label: fact

evidence.note: Owen reported finance view as nice to have.

evidence.label: opinion

evidence.label: opinion

evidence.label: opinion

contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes an unmet need for the customer's own payback number that was never built or quantified.
Rep says 'It's timing' and that it will return, but also reports finance viewed it as a nice-to-have, which suggests a priority problem, not just timing.
Rep names Diane as decider but never spoke to her, she was in no meetings, and all knowledge comes through Owen.
Rep says 'we were in procurement' then corrects to 'we'd sent paper'; the deal was not as far along as first implied.
Rep first says nothing got silence, then names the revenue framing, which Owen explicitly rejected.
Timing of the payback ask: 'maybe a month' and later 'about a month'; consistent but hedged.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Rep says she doesn't know that anything got silence, then reluctantly offers the revenue framing.

dodges.question: Anything else?
dodges.what: Rep closes with a blanket 'nothing we could have done', skipping the gaps she described earlier.

dodges.question: Who made the final call, and how do you know?
dodges.what: Rep hedges ('I guess?') and says she doesn't know it was a decision against us; basis is only Owen's account.
